svg.title: GSM8K accuracy across four language models
svg.desc: Llama-3-8B: Uniform Weighting: 60.06%; RHO-LOSS: 65.43%; LESS: 74.45%; ScaleBiO: 66.19%; HG-baseline: 73.77%; HG-MS: 74.85%. Qwen-2-7B: Uniform Weighting: 60.03%; RHO-LOSS: 63.15%; LESS: 65.28%; ScaleBiO: 75.74%; HG-baseline: 68.46%; HG-MS: 82.03%. Gemma-2-9B: Uniform Weighting: 78.08%; RHO-LOSS: 78.47%; LESS: 79.28%; ScaleBiO: 79.62%; HG-baseline: 80.14%; HG-MS: 80.86%. Qwen2.5-32B: Uniform Weighting: 78.19%; RHO-LOSS: OOM, no completed run; LESS: OOM, no completed run; ScaleBiO: 88.40%; HG-baseline: 86.81%; HG-MS: 92.58%. Single-seed results from Tables 2 and 3(a). All completed rows share final one-epoch fine-tuning on 20,000 examples. Iterative methods share per-backbone reweighting budgets; non-iterative methods have no outer-loop budget. OOM means out of memory, not zero accuracy.
